claims.claim: Hugging Face Trainer accepts model, TrainingArguments, train/eval datasets, tokenizer, data collator and compute_metrics.
claims.verification_note: Example is pinned to the documented version.

claims.claim: DataCollatorWithPadding dynamically pads a batch to the longest sequence in that batch.
Fast tokenizers expose word_ids for mapping sub-token positions to original words; a common strategy labels only the first sub-token and ignores continuation pieces with -100.
claims.locator: Token classification preprocessing and label alignment
claims.verification_note: First-subtoken policy is presented as one valid strategy, not the only strategy.

claims.claim: Question-answering preprocessing uses offset mappings and overflow windows to map character spans to token positions.
claims.verification_note: Explains why truncation and stride are part of preprocessing.

claims.claim: BERT fine-tuning initializes task-specific models from pretrained parameters and updates them on task labels.
Validation is used for model selection and hyperparameter choice; the test split is reserved for final evaluation.
claims.verification_note: Methodology statement, not a benchmark claim.
